newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Romanian President Emil Constantinescu and Foreign Minister Adrian Severin are in Amsterdam attending a European Union meeting briefing the leaders of 12 aspirant countries on the state of the EU after its recent summit which agreed on a new treaty.
Constantinescu will give a news conference in Amsterdam at 4 p.m. Bucharest time.

* U.S. President Bill Clinton will visit Romania after the July 8-9 NATO summit in Madrid to assure Romania that it is an excellent candidate for joining NATO in the second wave of the Alliance's eastward expansion.
* The lower Chamber of Deputies continued debates on a new land restitution bill replacing the previous one from 1991.
* The lower house will decide on Monday whether it will hold an extraordinary session over July 1 to 11, as decided by its leading board. Parliament should go into summer recess on June 30.
